question: Can players respond to my choice of a +1/+1 counter or haste for riot?

expected.shortAnswer: No: riot is a replacement effect, so players cannot respond to your choice.
expected.answer: Riot is a replacement effect. Players can't respond to your choice of a +1/+1 counter or haste.
